result.notes: Otter's REST/webhook Public API (Bearer-token API keys, ~7 documented endpoints across channel/conversation/workspace resources plus webhooks) is restricted to Enterprise-plan workspaces and may require admin permissions to enable; workspaces that don't see the Developer tab must contact their Otter account manager. Otter also runs an official OAuth-authenticated remote MCP server for meeting-transcript search/summarization, again positioned as an enterprise offering ("Request a demo"). Could not directly fetch the help.otter.ai pages (403 to normal WebFetch; used a read-proxy) so treat exact endpoint counts as approximate.
result.one_liner: Otter.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes conversations, exposing an Enterprise-gated REST API and an official OAuth MCP server for querying meeting transcripts/insights.
